blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Anomaly detection (AD) is often framed as a representation-learning problem, where strong performance is expected to require learned features or AD-specific optimization. However, this view can overlook the intrinsic separability of anomalies from normal references, even in the absence of learned representations. We therefore investigate how far untrained neural networks can go in anomaly detection. To this end, we propose PRISM, a framework combining fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring for tabular detection and dense visual localization. Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods. On MVTec AD and VisA, covering 27 visual categories, PRISM-V achieves mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively. Notably, both models achieve these results without neural weight optimization or pretrained representations. A theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the Mahalanobis score gap, while empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability. These findings establish PRISM as both a competitive anomaly detector and a prior-to-learning baseline for assessing the added value of learned representations in anomaly detection.
blocks.zh: 异常检测(AD)往往被描述为一种表现学习问题,在这种情况下,强效预期需要学习的特征或针对AD的优化。 然而,这种观点可能忽略了异常现象与正常引用的内在分离性,即使没有学到的表述。 因此,我们调查未经训练的神经网络在异常检测中能走多远. 为此,我们提出PRISM,一个将固定随机非线性特征与正常参考的Mahalanobis评分相结合的框架,用于表格检测和密集的视觉局部化. 在亚行的47个表格数据集中,PRISM-T在比较方法中实现了最高的AUROC(86.4%)和第二高的AUPRC(65.9%)。 在MVTec AD和VisA上,包含27个视觉类,PRISM-V分别实现90.4%和96.4%的平均图像级和像素级的AUROC. 值得注意的是,这两个模型都实现了这些结果,没有进行神经重量优化或预先训练的表示. 一项理论分析进一步定性非线性转变如何影响对马哈拉诺比斯分数差距的平均值和共变性贡献,而经验分析则研究了由此产生的分数分离性. 这些调查结果将PRISM确定为一种竞争性异常探测器和在学习前评估在异常探测中学到的表述的附加值的基准。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Anomaly detection (AD) is fundamentally a problem of identifying deviation from normality.
Unlike conventional predictive learning, anomalies need not be observed during model construction; a model may instead characterize normal data and determine how strongly a new observation departs from that reference.
Modern AD methods nevertheless devote substantial modeling effort to constructing representations or scoring spaces in which deviations from normality become easier to expose.
Depending on the formulation, this may involve learning compact representations of normal data through reconstruction or one-class objectives [ 1 , 2 ] , characterizing local neighborhoods or normal-data geometry [ 3 , 4 ] , modeling the normal distribution through generative or score-based objectives [ 5 , 6 ] , or leveraging pretrained representations in which semantic or structural deviations become more discernible [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
Such approaches reflect a common emphasis on learned representations as a key source of anomaly separability.
blocks.zh:
异常检测(AD)从根本上来说是一个识别偏离常态的问题.
与常规的预测性学习不同,在模型构建过程中不需要观察到异常现象;相反,一个模型可以描述正常数据的特征,并确定新的观测偏离该参考的力度。
然而,现代反倾销方法在构建表述或评分空间方面投入了大量的建模努力,在这种空间中,偏离正常性变得更容易暴露。
视表述方式而定,这可能涉及通过重建或单一类目标[1,2]来学习对正常数据的紧凑表示,描述局部邻里或正常数据几何[3,4],通过基因或记分目标[5,6]来模拟正常分布[5,6],或利用语义或结构偏差变得更加明显的预先训练过的表示[7,8,9].
这种做法反映出人们共同强调,吸取教训的表述是造成异常分离的关键根源。

blocks.en:
Yet a simpler possibility remains.
If abnormality is defined relative to normal data, some anomaly evidence may already be intrinsic to the data, even before representation learning.
Intuitively, we often sense that “something looks wrong” before we can precisely identify which rule or regularity has been violated.
We therefore ask a basic but easily overlooked question: how far can anomaly detection go before learning?
blocks.zh:
然而,还有一个更简单的可能性。
如果相对于正常数据定义异常性,一些异常证据可能已经是数据固有的,甚至在表现学习之前.
直觉上,我们常常感到,在我们能够准确确定哪些规则或规则被违反之前,“看似错了”。
因此,我们提出一个基本但容易被忽略的问题:在学习之前,异常现象的发现能走多远?

blocks.en:
This prior-to-learning perspective was partially explored in an earlier study on untrained neural networks (UNNs), which showed that randomly initialized neural features combined with Mahalanobis scoring can detect anomalies without neural weight optimization [ 10 ] .
However, the evidence remained limited in both breadth and granularity: the tabular evaluation covered only a small set of datasets, while the visual experiments were restricted to flattened MNIST and F-MNIST with image-level scoring.
It therefore remained unclear whether prior-to-learning separability could support competitive detection across diverse tabular datasets or enable dense visual localization.
blocks.zh:
早期对未经训练的神经网络(UNNs)的研究表明,随机初始化的神经特征与Mahalanobis积分相结合,可以检测异常,而无需优化神经重量[10].
然而,证据在广度和颗粒性两方面都仍然有限:表格评价仅涵盖一小组数据集,而视觉实验则仅限于平整的MNIST和F-MIST,具有图像级别评分.
因此,尚不清楚的是,在学习之前的分离性是否能够支持不同表格数据集之间的竞争性检测,或者是否能够实现密集的视觉本地化。

blocks.en:
To investigate this question, we propose PRISM (Prior-to-learning Random Intrinsic Scoring Model), a framework that exploits intrinsic anomaly evidence through frozen, randomly initialized neural features and normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring.
At its core, PRISM is built upon a simple and lightweight PRISM block consisting of a randomly initialized linear operator, normalization, and kinked nonlinear activation.
This design principle is instantiated in two modality-specific models: PRISM-T for global tabular anomaly detection and PRISM-V for dense visual anomaly localization.
Neither model optimizes neural weights or relies on pretrained representations.
For tabular AD, PRISM-T achieves competitive performance against recent state-of-the-art detectors across 47 ADBench datasets.
For visual AD, PRISM-V achieves strong image-level detection and extends prior-to-learning AD to spatially coherent pixel-level localization on industrial anomaly benchmarks.
These results demonstrate the potential of prior-to-learning anomaly detection across tabular and visual domains, establishing PRISM as a competitive detector built on lightweight, untrained neural feature extractors and a reference for assessing the added value of learned representations.
blocks.zh:
为了调查这个问题,我们提出PISM(先学习随机分泌模型),这个框架通过冷冻的随机初始神经特征和正常参考的Mahalanobis积分来利用内在异常证据。
其核心是PISM,它基于一个简单而轻量级的PISM块,由一个随机初始化的线性操作器,正常化,以及亲切的非线性激活组成.
这一设计原则在两种模式特定模式中被即时化:用于全球表格异常检测的PRISM-T和用于密集视觉异常本地化的PRISM-V.
无论是模型都无法优化神经权重,或者依赖于预先训练的表达.
就表格AD而言,PISM-T在47个亚行数据集的最近最先进的探测器上取得了竞争力。
对于视觉AD,PRISM-V实现强大的图像水平检测,并将事先学习的AD扩展至工业异常基准上空间一致的像素水平本地化.
这些结果表明,在表格和视觉领域进行事先学习的异常检测具有潜力,将PRISM确立为一种以轻量级、未经训练的神经特征提取器为基础的竞争性检测器,并用作评估所学表现的附加值的参考。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下。

blocks.en:

Through modality-specific implementations, PRISM extends untrained neural anomaly detection from tabular data to visual anomaly detection and localization. • We conduct a comprehensive evaluation from tables to pixels, spanning 47 tabular datasets from ADBench and 27 visual categories from MVTec AD and VisA.
For tabular AD, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC and the second-highest mean AUPRC among the compared detectors, while PRISM-V demonstrates strong image-level detection and pixel-level localization.
Both models achieve these results using fully untrained neural networks with substantially fewer parameters than the compared state-of-the-art neural AD models. • We investigate the mechanisms underlying prior-to-learning anomaly separability through theoretical and empirical analyses.
The theory characterizes how nonlinear feature transformations affect the mean and covariance contributions to the expected Mahalanobis score gap.
Experiments further examine the resulting score separability and its relationship with detection performance across both modalities.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Anomaly detection and tabular benchmarks
blocks.zh: II-A 异常检测和表格基准

blocks.en:
Tabular AD has long relied on diverse classical approaches, with methods such as Isolation forest, kNN, LOF, and OCSVM continuing to serve as competitive baselines [ 11 , 12 ] .
ADBench [ 12 ] further standardized large-scale tabular evaluation and highlighted the difficulty arising from substantial variation in data structure and anomaly characteristics.
Alongside these classical approaches, neural methods have increasingly been explored to capture more complex nonlinear structures in tabular data.
Recent neural tabular AD methods extend these classical principles by learning representations, nonlinear dependencies, and relational structures.
Some methods learn representations through contrastive, masked, or disentangled objectives [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] ; others refine outlier scoring through neighborhood- or graph-based modeling, as in LUNAR [ 3 ] .
State-of-the-art approaches have increasingly adopted perturbation-based objectives, modeling normality through responses to noise or time-conditioned transformations.
This trend spans diffusion-time estimation, score matching, and flow-matching-inspired approaches, as exemplified by DTE [ 5 ] , K-DSM [ 16 ] , and TCCM [ 6 ] .
Emerging work further explores LLM- or foundation-model-inspired tabular detectors [ 17 ] .
Despite their methodological diversity, most recent high-performing approaches rely on neural modeling and task-specific training to construct anomaly representations or scoring functions.
blocks.zh:
表格AD长期以来一直依赖不同的古典方法,孤立森林、kNN、LOF和OCSVM等方法继续作为竞争性基线[11、12]。
ADBench [12]进一步标准化了大规模表格评价,并强调了数据结构和异常特征的巨大差异所产生的困难。
除了这些古典方法外,人们还越来越多地探索神经方法,以在表格数据中捕捉更为复杂的非线性结构.
最近的神经表AD方法通过学习表现、非线性依赖和关系结构来扩展这些经典原则。
一些方法通过对比性、蒙蔽性或分散性的目标[13、14、15]来学习表达;另一些方法则通过邻里或图示模型来改进比值。
最新方法越来越多地采用基于扰动的目标,通过对噪音或有时间限制的转变作出反应,模拟正常情况。
这一趋势跨越传播时间估计、分数比对和流量比对激励办法,例如DTE [5]、K-DSM [16]和TCCM [6]。
新兴工作进一步探索LLM-或基础模型启发式表格探测器[17].
尽管方法多种多样,但最近的高性能方法依赖于神经模型和针对具体任务的培训,以构建异常表达或评分功能.

blocks.en: II-B Visual anomaly detection and localization
blocks.zh: II-B 视觉异常探测和本地化

blocks.en:
Early deep visual AD methods often treated an image as a single observation, using reconstruction, generative modeling, or one-class representation learning to produce image-level anomaly scores or coarse residual-based maps [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
Industrial visual AD later shifted its emphasis toward dense localization, modeling normality at the patch or spatial-location level rather than treating each image as a single observation.
Representative methods such as SPADE [ 22 ] , PaDiM [ 7 ] , and PatchCore [ 4 ] established a pretrained feature paradigm based on nearest-neighbor retrieval, location-wise Gaussian modeling, or memory-bank comparison.
This reliance on pretrained visual representations has more recently extended to foundation models, including vision-language models and self-supervised visual backbones, as exemplified by WinCLIP [ 23 ] , AnomalyDINO [ 8 ] , and SubspaceAD [ 9 ] .
Although such methods are commonly described as training-free , they avoid task-specific feature learning while still relying on representations acquired through large-scale pretraining.
We use the term prior-to-learning to distinguish the setting considered in PRISM , where the neural feature extractor is randomly initialized and remains fixed without feature learning or pretraining.
Accordingly, PRISM-V investigates visual anomaly detection and dense localization using only untrained visual representations.
blocks.zh:
早期的深视AD方法往往将图像作为单一的观测,使用重建,基因模型,或一等代表学习生成图像级异常分数或粗余基地图[18,19,20,21].
工业视觉AD后来将其重点转向密集的局部化,在补丁或空间定位层面模拟常态,而不是将每个图像作为单一的观测.
SPADE [22],PADIM [7],PatchCore [4] 等代表方法根据最近的邻域检索,位置上的高斯建模,或内存-库比较,建立了预先训练的特征范式.
这种对预先训练的视觉表现的依赖,最近已扩展到基础模型,包括视觉语言模型和自我监督的视觉骨干,例如WinCLIP [23],AnomalyDINO [8],和SubspaceAD [9].
虽然这些方法通常被描述为无培训,但它们避免了任务特定特征的学习,而仍然依赖于通过大规模预训获得的表述。
我们使用“学前”一词来区分PISM中考虑的设置,其中神经特征提取器是随机初始化的,并且保持不变,没有特征学习或预训。
因此,PRISM-V只使用未经训练的视觉表现来调查视觉异常检测和密集本地化.

blocks.en: II-C Random features and untrained networks
blocks.zh: II-C 随机特征和未经培训的网络

blocks.en:
Although random features may seem to lack learned semantic or task-specific information, fixed random transformations have long been studied for the useful geometric structure they can induce.
For example, the Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma shows that random linear projections can approximately preserve pairwise Euclidean distances [ 24 ] .
Likewise, randomly weighted neural networks have been studied as nonlinear embeddings that reshape distances and angles [ 25 ] .
This geometric perspective has also been extended to randomly initialized CNNs, including the effects of convolution and ReLU on angular preservation and contraction [ 26 ] .
These studies establish that random neural mappings can preserve or reshape useful geometric structure, but do not directly address whether the resulting representations expose anomaly separability.
In the tabular domain, UNN [ 10 ] provided empirical evidence that nonlinear features from a randomly initialized multilayer perceptron (MLP), combined with Mahalanobis scoring, can support competitive anomaly detection without training.
DIF [ 27 ] employs an ensemble of randomly initialized MLPs to construct nonlinear feature spaces where isolation forests are applied for anomaly scoring.
In visual AD, prior studies have noted that random weights can yield above-chance performance [ 28 , 29 ] , but only in auxiliary or ablation analyses rather than as systematic investigations of fully untrained detection.
Despite these findings, whether prior-to-learning representations can support competitive detection across diverse tabular problems and dense visual anomaly localization remains underexplored. PRISM extends this line of inquiry through a unified investigation of large-scale tabular detection and dense visual localization, together with modality-specific design and a score-level analysis of prior-to-learning separability.
blocks.zh:
尽管随机特征可能似乎缺乏学到的语义或任务特定信息,但固定随机变换早已被研究,以了解它们能够诱导的有用的几何结构.
例如,Johnson–Lindenstrauss lemma显示,随机线性预测可以大致保持双智的欧几里得距离[24].
同样,随机加权神经网络也被作为重塑距离和角度的非线性嵌入体研究 [25].
这种几何视角也被扩展至随机初始化的CNN,包括革命和ReLU对角保护和收缩的影响[26].
这些研究确定随机神经映射可以保存或重塑有用的几何结构,但并不直接解决由此产生的表达是否暴露出异常的分离性.
在表格领域,UNN[10]提供了经验证据,证明随机初始化的多层受体(MLP)的非线性特征,加上Mahalanobis评分,可以支持不经过培训的竞争性异常检测.
DIF[27]利用随机初始化的MLP组合来构建非线性特征空间,将孤立森林应用于异常评分.
在视觉AD中,先前的研究指出,随机权重可以产生高于跳动性能[28,29],但只能通过辅助分析或衰竭分析,而不是作为对完全未经训练的检测的系统调查.
尽管有这些发现,在学习前的表述能否支持对各种表格问题进行竞争性检测,而密集的视觉异常局部化仍然没有得到充分探讨。 PRISM通过对大规模表型检测和密集的视觉局部化进行统一调查,同时进行模式特定设计和对学前分离性的分数级分析,延长了这一查询线.

PRISM uses fixed random transformations to reveal intrinsic normal–anomalous separability without learning feature weights.
This principle leads to two modality-specific instantiations: PRISM-T for tabular AD and PRISM-V for location-wise visual AD.
In each instantiation, one or more PRISM blocks (PBs) induce a nonlinear random transformation, after which the resulting features are scored by their Mahalanobis distance from reference statistics.

blocks.en:
We evaluate PRISM on three widely adopted anomaly detection benchmarks: ADBench [ 12 ] for tabular AD, and MVTec AD [ 33 ] and VisA [ 34 ] for visual AD.
Tabular experiments cover the 47 classical datasets in ADBench, excluding the 10 additional CV/NLP datasets represented by pretrained embeddings to maintain a prior-to-learning evaluation setting.
Following recent normal-only protocols, 50% of the normal samples are randomly selected as the training set for learning-based baselines [ 15 , 6 ] and as the reference set for PRISM-T .
The remaining normal samples and all anomalous samples constitute the test set.
AUROC and AUPRC are evaluated, with mean scores and average ranks reported across datasets.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了三个广泛采用的异常检测基准:ADBench [12]为表格AD,MVTec AD [33]和VisA [34]为视觉AD。
表格实验覆盖了亚行47个古典数据集,不包括10个额外的CV/NLP数据集,这些数据集以预先训练的嵌入为代表,以维持一个学前评价设置.
遵循最近的普通唯一协议,50%的正常样本被随机选作基于学习的基线的培训集[15,6]和PRISM-T的参考集.
其余的正常样本和所有异常样本构成测试集.
评估了非洲统一办事处和非盟项目审查委员会,并报告各数据集的平均分数和平均排名。

blocks.en:
Visual experiments cover 15 categories of industrial objects and textures in MVTec AD and 12 categories in VisA, including complex multi-instance scenes.
For MVTec AD, the defect-free training split serves as the normal reference set, and evaluation uses the official test split.
For VisA, we follow the official one-class protocol, using 90% of normal images for reference and the remaining normals plus all anomalies for testing. Image-level performance is evaluated using AUROC and AUPRC, and pixel-level localization using AUROC and area under the per-region overlap curve (AUPRO) [ 35 ] .
All metrics range from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating better performance. For both tabular and visual evaluations, experimental results are averaged over five random seeds.
Throughout the tables, the best and second-best results are highlighted in bold and underlined.
For brevity, some tables use AUC, AUP, and PRO for AUROC, AUPRC, and AUPRO, respectively, with I- and P- indicating image- and pixel-level metrics.

对于MVTec AD来说,无缺陷训练分裂作为一般的参考集,评价使用正式测试分裂.

所有度量衡从0到1不等,更高的值表明性能更好. 就表型和视觉评价而言,实验结果平均为5个随机种子。
各表以粗体和下划线突出最佳和次佳成果。

Table I summarizes the modality-specific architectural designs and the resulting hyperparameter settings.
A single global configuration is selected for each modality using three preselected development datasets or categories ( PRISM-T : Pima, Fault , and SpamBase ; PRISM-V : cable, hazelnut , and carpet from MVTec AD) and then fixed across all evaluations without per-dataset tuning.

使用三个预选开发数据集或类别(PISM-T:Pima, Fault,和SpamBase;PISM-V:电缆,hazelnut,和MVTec AD的地毯)为每种模式选择一个单一的全球配置,然后在所有评价中固定,而不进行每个数据集的调试。

blocks.en:
Tabular AD performance is compared against 14 detectors, including recent state-of-the-art methods such as DTE-NP [ 5 ] , AnoDDAE [ 36 ] , TCCM [ 6 ] , and DenoiserAD [ 37 ] .
The comparison also covers strong baselines from prior large-scale benchmarks, such as LUNAR [ 3 ] and KDE [ 38 ] , as well as methods using untrained neural features, including DIF [ 27 ] and UNN [ 10 ] .
Due to computational resource constraints, KDE, OCSVM, and DenoiserAD are fitted using 10,000 randomly selected normal training samples on the nine datasets with over 50,000 samples ( backdoor, smtp, skin, celeba, census, cover, fraud, http, and donors ).
The test sets remain unchanged.
blocks.zh:
将表格式AD性能比作14个探测器,包括最近最先进的方法,如DTE-NP [5],AnoDAE [36],TCCM [6],和DenoiserAD [37].
比较还包括以往大型基准的强基线,如LUNAR[3]和KDE[38],以及使用未经训练的神经特征的方法,包括DIF[27]和UNN[10].
由于计算资源的限制,KDE、OCSVM和DenoiserAD在9个数据集(后门、smtp、皮肤、celeba、人口普查、覆盖、欺诈、http和捐赠者)上使用10,000个随机选择的正常培训样本。
测试装置保持不变。

blocks.en:
In the visual AD setting, evaluation is conducted against eight baselines, including generative models (VAE [ 39 ] and GANomaly [ 19 ] ) and pretrained-feature methods.
The latter include conventional CNN-based approaches (SPADE [ 22 ] , PaDiM [ 7 ] , and PatchCore [ 4 ] ) and recent foundation-model-based methods (WinCLIP+ [ 23 ] , AnomalyDINO [ 8 ] , and SubspaceAD [ 9 ] ).
For VAE, we adopt a CNN encoder and a symmetric decoder based on the PRISM-V architecture and generate pixel-level anomaly maps from reconstruction errors following prior studies [ 40 , 41 ] .
The hyperparameters of VAE and GANomaly are selected using the same three MVTec AD development categories used for PRISM-V and fixed across both visual benchmarks.
All other baselines use publicly available implementations from PyOD, scikit-learn, or the original studies with their provided or default hyperparameter settings.
Table II provides an overview of the baseline methods, their neural network training and anomaly scoring mechanisms.

对于VAE,我们采用基于PRISM-V架构的CNN编码器和对称解码器,并从之前的研究之后的重建错误中生成像素级异常图[40,41].

blocks.en:
For PRISM-T , input features are z-score standardized and passed through a single PB consisting of a frozen fully connected layer, mixed instance–batch normalization, and LeakyReLU.
All dataset-level statistics are estimated solely from the reference set.
The random weights are initialized from 𝒰 ( − 1 / d , 1 / d ) \mathcal{U}(-1/\sqrt{d},1/\sqrt{d}) .
For PRISM-V , input images are resized to 256 and center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , a resolution commonly used in visual AD [ 7 , 4 ] .
Baseline methods retain their original preprocessing and input resolution settings.
The feature extractor comprises five convolutional PBs with BlurPool downsampling, and the convolutional weights follow He normal initialization [ 42 ] .
Feature taps are fixed at 𝒯 = { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } \mathcal{T}=\{2,3,4,5\} .
The tapped feature maps are bilinearly upsampled to a 112 × 112 112\times 112 grid and concatenated for location-wise Mahalanobis scoring.
The reference mean and covariance are estimated per grid location, with covariance matrices averaged over a 3 × 3 3\times 3 window before regularization and inversion.
Gaussian smoothing uses σ = 4 \sigma=4 , and TVaR aggregation uses a tail ratio of ρ = 1 % \rho=1\% .

Table III summarizes the results on 47 ADBench datasets in terms of mean performance with standard deviations, statistical significance, and top-two counts.
Despite using entirely untrained neural features, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC of 86.4 % 86.4\% and the second-highest mean AUPRC of 65.9 % 65.9\% .

Compared with previous untrained neural feature-based methods, PRISM-T improves upon UNN by 3.5 % 3.5\% and 8.0 % 8.0\% , and DIF by 13.4 % 13.4\% and 36.7 % 36.7\% in AUROC and AUPRC, respectively.

blocks.en:
Beyond detection performance, Fig. 5 compares the computational efficiency of leading methods in terms of model-construction and inference times.
Construction time measures the execution of the fit() procedure, while inference time measures the time required to score the test samples.
Existing AD methods exhibit different computational trade-offs.
Nearest-neighbor and kernel-based detectors (e.g., DTE-NP, KDE, and LUNAR) require comparisons with reference samples during inference, leading to increased inference time as the reference set grows.
In contrast, deep learning-based detectors enable efficient inference but require costly weight optimization during model construction.
LUNAR suffers from both reference-sample comparisons and neural weight optimization, resulting in higher costs in both stages. PRISM-T avoids both sources of computational overhead by eliminating neural weight optimization and repeated reference-sample comparisons during inference.
As shown in Fig. 5 , PRISM-T achieves low construction and inference costs.
Its lightweight architecture uses only 41K neural parameters on average, approximately 0.16%–30.4% of those in the compared recent neural models.
Based on average execution times across 47 datasets, PRISM-T on CPU achieves 18 18 – 156 × 156\times faster inference than the nearest-neighbor and kernel-based detectors, and 38 38 – 6,824 × 6{,}824\times faster model construction than the deep learning detectors.
Moreover, its neural architecture readily supports GPU acceleration through existing deep learning frameworks, further speeding up model construction and inference by 7.4 × 7.4\times and 21.6 × 21.6\times , respectively, compared with its CPU implementation.

相比之下,基于深层学习的探测器能够有效推导,但在模型构建过程中需要成本高昂的重量优化.
LUNAR同时受到参考样本比较和神经重量优化的影响,导致两个阶段的成本都较高. PRISM-T通过在推论中消除神经重量优化和重复的参考样本比较,避免了计算间接费用的两个来源.
如图5所示,PISM-T的建造成本和推论成本较低。
其轻量级建筑平均仅使用41K神经参数,约占比较近代神经模型中的0.16%–30.4%.
根据47个数据集的平均执行时间,CPU上的PRISM-T实现了18 18 — 156 × 156\的推论比最近的邻里和内核探测器更快,38 38 — 6 824 × 6{,}824\的模型构建比深层学习探测器更快.
此外,它的神经架构通过现有的深层学习框架,随时支持GPU加速,与它的CPU执行相比,它分别进一步加速了7.4×7.4\时和21.6×21.6\时的模型构建和推论.

blocks.en: Overall, these results demonstrate that PRISM-T combines performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods with low computational costs in both stages, establishing an efficient prior-to-learning baseline for tabular AD.

blocks.en:
Table IV presents image-level detection and pixel-level localization results on MVTec AD and VisA.
Despite relying entirely on randomly initialized networks, PRISM-V achieves image-level AUROC scores of 92.9 92.9 and 87.3 87.3 , with corresponding AUPRC scores of 97.2 97.2 and 89.1 89.1 , respectively.
This capability extends to dense anomaly localization, achieving pixel-level AUROC scores of 96.2 96.2 and 96.7 96.7 and AUPRO scores of 85.9 85.9 and 73.1 73.1 . PRISM-V substantially outperforms earlier deep learning methods (VAE and GANomaly) on the reported metrics, although a performance gap remains relative to recent pretrained-feature methods.
Among the four evaluation metrics, PRISM-V is most competitive in pixel-level AUROC, showing the smallest gap to the best-performing method on both benchmarks.
To quantify its relative performance across categories and metrics, we use the performance retention ratio (PRR), defined as the average ratio of each category- and metric-specific score to the corresponding best score. PRISM-V achieves PRRs of 94.1 % 94.1\% on MVTec AD and 87.8 % 87.8\% on VisA, comparable to those of some pretrained-feature methods (SPADE and WinCLIP+).
Notably, these results are achieved with entirely random neural weights and only 0.33M parameters, less than 0.5% of those in the pretrained neural networks used by SPADE and WinCLIP+.
This suggests that substantial visual anomaly evidence can be exploited through random nonlinear features and Mahalanobis scoring alone, without learned visual representations.

blocks.en:
To examine performance variations across object categories, Figs. 6 and 7 present the per-category results.
At the image level, PRISM-V achieves AUROC scores above 90 90 in 12 of the 15 MVTec AD categories, including a perfect score on Toothbrush .
It also outperforms PaDiM and WinCLIP+ on PCB1 – PCB3 in VisA, although performance varies across categories, particularly on Screw , Capsules , and Macaroni2 .
At the pixel level, all 27 categories achieve AUROC scores above 90 90 , with 20 categories scoring at least 95 95 . PRISM-V also achieves higher pixel-level AUROC than multiple pretrained-feature methods in several categories, surpassing five of the six compared methods on Transistor and four on Cashew .
At the region level, AUPRO provides a complementary assessment by measuring the coverage of individual anomaly regions.
On Transistor , PRISM-V surpasses four pretrained-feature methods in AUPRO.
In contrast, Cashew and Pipe fryum achieve pixel-level AUROC scores of 99.0 99.0 and 99.1 99.1 , respectively, while their corresponding AUPRO scores are 73.1 73.1 and 78.1 78.1 .

For tabular AD, random transformation improves AUROC and AUPRC over Raw.
Introducing LeakyReLU nonlinearity further improves AUROC by 3.8 % 3.8\% and AUPRC by 11.1 % 11.1\% , with a more pronounced improvement in AUPRC.

LeakyReLU further enhances detection and localization, particularly AUPRO, which rises from 75.4 % 75.4\% to 80.2 % 80.2\% .
This improvement is accompanied by increased score-level separability at both the image and pixel levels, reaching G img = 0.74 G_{\mathrm{img}}=0.74 and G pix = 0.78 G_{\mathrm{pix}}=0.78 .

Overall, these results demonstrate that random nonlinear representations in PRISM improve anomaly detection over observation-space scoring in both modalities, consistent with the mechanisms discussed in Section IV .
The associated changes in score-level separability are examined in the following analyses.

blocks.en: VI-B Analysis of PRISM-T
blocks.zh: VI-B PRISM-T分析

blocks.en:
The PRISM framework consists of two components: untrained neural feature transformation and Mahalanobis scoring.
To examine their respective contributions, we compare alternative nonlinear random features and anomaly scoring rules while keeping the other component fixed.
blocks.zh:
PRISM框架由两个部分组成:未经训练的神经特征转化和Mahalanobis评分.
为了审查它们各自的贡献,我们比较其他非线性随机特征和异常评分规则,同时保持其他组件固定.

blocks.en:
Table VI (a) compares PRISM-T with three existing random nonlinear
feature transformations: Fourier [ 43 ] , Maclaurin [ 44 ] , and ReLU [ 45 ] .
Note that the ReLU feature map differs from simply replacing the activation function in PRISM-T , as it uses a bias-free Gaussian random projection without normalization.
All transformations produce 512-dimensional features and use the same scoring procedure.
Under these conditions, PRISM-T achieves
the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC, followed by ReLU.
Table VI (b) compares scoring rules applied to the same PRISM-T features.
Mahalanobis scoring achieves the highest mean AUROC and AUPRC, exceeding k k NN by 1.0 and 2.0 percentage points (pp), respectively.
While k k NN achieves comparable performance, it requires nearest-neighbor search over the reference samples at inference.
Mahalanobis scoring instead uses a precomputed mean and precision matrix, making its per-sample scoring cost independent of the reference-set size.
Its substantial advantage over Euclidean scoring further highlights the value of accounting for covariance in the feature space.

Together, the two comparisons support the combination of random neural feature transformation and Mahalanobis scoring in PRISM-T .
The architecture provides an effective nonlinear representation, while covariance-aware scoring translates deviations in that representation into anomaly scores.

Tabular AD provides a direct setting for this analysis, as each sample receives a single anomaly score corresponding to the class-conditional score distributions considered in the theory.

The resulting improvements in score-level separability are associated with improved anomaly detection performance, supporting the role of random nonlinear representations in exposing intrinsic anomaly separability.

blocks.en:
To further investigate the effectiveness of random feature representations in visual AD, we replace the pretrained backbone originally used by each baseline with a randomly initialized counterpart, while retaining its anomaly scoring procedure.
These backbones include Wide ResNet [ 46 ] , CLIP [ 47 ] , and DINOv2 [ 48 ] , as detailed in Table VIII .
Across the six randomly initialized baselines, image-level AUROC ranges from 60.8 to 79.5, while AUPRO ranges from 43.5 to 60.2.
In contrast, PRISM-V achieves 90.4 and 80.2, exceeding the strongest baselines by 10.9 pp and 20.0 pp, respectively.
Notably, PaDiM achieves the highest image-level AUROC among the baselines and employs a similar scoring principle based on location-specific Mahalanobis distance, yet remains substantially below PRISM-V .
These results support the effectiveness of PRISM-V ’s architectural design in exploiting random neural features for visual anomaly detection.

Figure 13 compares the anomaly localization results of PRISM-V , PaDiM, and SubspaceAD across the five highest- and five lowest-AUPRO categories for PRISM-V .
In the top-5 categories, PRISM-V produces concentrated anomaly responses around the ground-truth defects, as illustrated by leather , screw , and zipper .
Both pixel AUROC and AUPRO remain high, with localization performance generally comparable to that of the pretrained-feature baselines.
These results demonstrate that randomly initialized CNN features can support precise anomaly localization without relying on learned visual representations.
In contrast, the bottom-5 categories exhibit less selective anomaly responses, often extending into normal object boundaries or surrounding structures, as observed in fryum , pcb4 , and chewinggum .
In categories with multiple similar objects, such as capsules and macaroni2 , anomaly responses also spread beyond the ground-truth defects.
SubspaceAD generally provides more focused localization in these cases.
Even in these challenging categories, PRISM-V exhibits elevated anomaly responses near some ground-truth defects, although these responses are less spatially selective and extend into normal regions.

blocks.en:
These visual results complement the quantitative findings by showing that PRISM-V produces localized anomaly responses in favorable categories while retaining sensitivity to defects in more challenging cases.
Together, they further demonstrate the potential of untrained neural features for anomaly localization.

blocks.en:
Table XI summarizes the modality-specific effects of normalization and pooling.
For PRISM-T , IN alone degrades performance, whereas IBN achieves the best results.
For PRISM-V , BlurPool and IN each improve performance, with their combination yielding the largest gains.
Table XII examines the effects of feature extractor width, depth, and activation functions.
Increasing feature width improves performance in both variants, although the gains tend to diminish at larger widths, while covariance estimation and inversion become more costly.
For PRISM-T , increasing depth provides no consistent improvement, suggesting limited benefits from stacking additional randomly initialized PBs.
Regarding activation functions, ReLU and LeakyReLU yield nearly identical results, whereas Tanh and Sigmoid generally degrade performance, particularly in visual anomaly localization.
In addition, spatially averaging location-wise covariance estimates over a 3 × 3 3\times 3 neighborhood improves performance in PRISM-V .
Compared with no spatial covariance averaging, image-level AUROC increases by 1.8 pp and 1.3 pp on MVTec AD and VisA, respectively.
The corresponding AUPRO gains are 0.2 pp and 0.5 pp.

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced PRISM , a prior-to-learning anomaly detection framework that combines fixed random nonlinear features with normal-reference Mahalanobis scoring.
Its core component is a PRISM block that follows the typical linear transformation–normalization–activation pattern in neural networks, using a randomly initialized linear operator and a kinked nonlinearity.
This design is instantiated in two modality-specific detectors: PRISM-T uses a single fully connected PRISM block with mixed instance and batch normalization for tabular anomaly scoring, while PRISM-V employs multi-scale convolutional features and location-wise scoring for visual anomaly localization.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了PISM, 一个在学习前的异常检测框架, 将固定的随机非线性特征与正常的参考 Mahalanobis 评分相结合.
其核心组件是遵循神经网络中典型的线性转变-正常化-激活模式的PRISM块,使用随机初始化的线性操作器和亲切的非线性.
这种设计在两种特定模式的探测器中即时化:PRISM-T使用一个完全连接的PRISM块,混合实例和批量正常化,用于表型异常分数,而PRISM-V则采用多尺度的转录特性和位置的分数,用于视觉异常局部化.

blocks.en:
Despite requiring neither pretraining nor neural weight optimization, both models achieve competitive detection performance.
Across 47 tabular datasets in ADBench, PRISM-T achieves the highest mean AUROC (86.4%) and the second-highest mean AUPRC (65.9%) among the compared methods, while ranking first on the largest number of datasets in terms of AUROC.
It also avoids stage-specific computational overhead, achieving up to 156 × \times faster inference than nearest-neighbor and kernel-based detectors and up to 6,824 × \times faster model construction than recent deep learning detectors.
For visual AD, PRISM-V demonstrates effective detection and localization on MVTec AD and VisA, achieving mean image-level and pixel-level AUROCs of 90.4% and 96.4%, respectively.
Across the evaluated metrics, it retains an average of 94.1% and 87.8% of the best category- and metric-specific scores on the respective benchmarks, using a fully untrained network with only 0.33M parameters, approximately 0.03%–1.5% of those used by the compared pretrained-feature detectors.
Our theoretical analysis further characterizes how nonlinear transformations affect the covariance and mean contributions to the expected Mahalanobis score gap.
Complementary empirical analyses examine the resulting score separability and its relationship with detection performance, while ablation studies assess the effects of key architectural choices.
blocks.zh:
尽管既不要求预先训练,也不要求神经重量优化,但这两种模式都实现了竞争性检测性能.
在亚行的47个表格数据集中,PrisM-T在比较方法中实现了最高的AUROC(86.4%)和第二高的AUPRC(65.9%),而就AUROC而言,在数量最多的数据集中排名第一。
这也避免了阶段特定的计算间接费用,实现了156××时的推论速度比最近的邻里和内核探测器快,以及6,824××时的模型构造速度比最近的深层学习探测器快.
对于视觉AD,PRISM-V在MVTec AD和VisA上演示有效的检测和本地化,实现平均图像水平和像素水平的AUROCs分别为90.4%和96.4%。
在整个被评价的衡量标准中,它使用一个完全未经培训的网络,只有0.33M参数,在相应的基准中平均保留了94.1%和87.8%的最佳类别和具体指标的分数,大约为比对的预测试检测器所用的分数的0.03%。
我们的理论分析进一步描述非线性转变如何影响共性,并意味着对预期的马哈拉诺比斯分数差距的贡献.
补充经验分析研究了由此产生的分数可分性及其与检测性能的关系,同时进行消融研究评估关键建筑选择的效果.

blocks.en: Together, these findings establish PRISM as a strong and computationally efficient prior-to-learning model across tabular and visual anomaly detection, providing a reference for assessing the added value of learned representations.
blocks.zh: 这些结论共同将PISM确立为在表征和视觉异常检测中具有强大和计算效率的学习前模式,为评估所学表现的附加值提供了参考。
